lines.text: Read pci_device_read_irq, InterruptAttachThread and InterruptWait in the probe. Clear stale status (ack 0x64), attach with TRK_MSK, arm a two-second TimerTimeout, raise bit 1 at 0x60, verify own pending bit at 0x24 and acknowledge before detach. Default attach initially unmasks: an extra unmask at count zero returns EAGAIN. Then inspect edu_dma_roundtrip: contiguous uncached MAP_PHYS memory, mem_offset physical range inside 32-bit dma_mask, checked bus mastering, two bounded 64-byte transfers and byte comparison. QEMU device buffer starts at 0x40000; never substitute a virtual pointer for the physical bus address. DMA completion is POLLED, not an IRQ claim. On failed quiescence the reference retains the allocation until the bounded external VM owner stops it.

A write is one complete command: 1–2 ASCII digits, optional LF, maximum three bytes, 0..12. Nonblocking requests return EAGAIN; results have per-open snapshots, offsets and EOF. Register /dev/edu mode 0660 only after PCI/BAR/IAT setup; dispatch remains a long-running process.

lines.text: # Step 5: IAT interrupt and polled DMA — solution
lines.label: UNVERIFIED unless bounded by REVIEW.md catalog
lines.note: Instruction/planned/expected/source-design text is not runtime proof; candidate references do not assert full sentence acceptance.

lines.text: ## Goal and source boundary
lines.label: UNVERIFIED unless bounded by REVIEW.md catalog
lines.note: Instruction/planned/expected/source-design text is not runtime proof; candidate references do not assert full sentence acceptance.

lines.text: Read pci_device_read_irq, InterruptAttachThread and InterruptWait in the probe. Clear stale status (ack 0x64), attach with TRK_MSK, arm a two-second TimerTimeout, raise bit 1 at 0x60, verify own pending bit at 0x24 and acknowledge before detach. Default attach initially unmasks: an extra unmask at count zero returns EAGAIN. Then inspect edu_dma_roundtrip: contiguous uncached MAP_PHYS memory, mem_offset physical range inside 32-bit dma_mask, checked bus mastering, two bounded 64-byte transfers and byte comparison. QEMU device buffer starts at 0x40000; never substitute a virtual pointer for the physical bus address. DMA completion is POLLED, not an IRQ claim. On failed quiescence the reference retains the allocation until the bounded external VM owner stops it.

lines.text: ## Goal and source boundary
lines.label: UNVERIFIED unless bounded by REVIEW.md catalog
lines.note: Instruction/planned/expected/source-design text is not runtime proof; candidate references do not assert full sentence acceptance.

lines.text: Read pci_device_read_irq, InterruptAttachThread and InterruptWait in the probe. Clear stale status (ack 0x64), attach with TRK_MSK, arm a two-second TimerTimeout, raise bit 1 at 0x60, verify own pending bit at 0x24 and acknowledge before detach. Default attach initially unmasks: an extra unmask at count zero returns EAGAIN. Then inspect edu_dma_roundtrip: contiguous uncached MAP_PHYS memory, mem_offset physical range inside 32-bit dma_mask, checked bus mastering, two bounded 64-byte transfers and byte comparison. QEMU device buffer starts at 0x40000; never substitute a virtual pointer for the physical bus address. DMA completion is POLLED, not an IRQ claim. On failed quiescence the reference retains the allocation until the bounded external VM owner stops it.

lines.text: Read factorial, parse_command, edu_write, edu_read and main in the resource-manager solution. One dispatch thread owns PCI, IAT and registers. Each synchronous successful write uses InterruptWait, checks pending AND not-busy, acknowledges and unmasks before publishing. No polling fallback. A write is one complete command: 1–2 ASCII digits, optional LF, maximum three bytes, 0..12. Nonblocking requests return EAGAIN; results have per-open snapshots, offsets and EOF. Register /dev/edu mode 0660 only after PCI/BAR/IAT setup; dispatch remains a long-running process.
